kb.a: Cory Anderson’s 1:00 PM call covers six deodorant scents at 5,000 units each, 30,000 total. Ronald has not yet confirmed aluminum-free capability, fill, or cure reality at that volume.

Lisa wants a bare-bones detox and clarifying shampoo for hard-water minerals, silicone buildup, and protein overload, with no proteins or heavy oils. Units are unknown; Sam must answer whether a stock base exists, while MOQ and turnaround remain open.

The Email Agent offered Natashia an occupied Wednesday slot, used 500 instead of the 1,000 custom-manufacturing minimum for Smoke’s Barbershop, and promised Yianni a pricing breakdown without BOM or owner. These are corrections, not completed work.
Two Friday 2:00 PM Delphos invites exist: the Email Agent’s Meet room and Delphos House’s own invite. Use Delphos House’s room and cancel the duplicate.

Phase 3 is blocked on three answers: whether a project begins at handoff acceptance, whether reopening a checked item is admin-only, and how samples link to production projects. The admin-only preview still needs human eyes, and task 587 needs deletion by an admin.
